note: Maps art keys to files in /src/art. 'rigs' are the characters: dragon.<stage> (painted with a red body and gold belly, recolored to each player's colors at load, with an element tail tip drawn on), rider ({weapon} is sword, bow or staff), rider.mounted, and enemy.<id>. Each is one painted image inside a 'torso' group that breathes; 'points' are spots on the image (mouth, hit, front, saddle) as fractions. A rig may still be built from several SVG or WebP parts drawn in place on a shared canvas, each with a pivot. Missing files fall back to placeholder shapes. See docs/ART_STYLE.md.
